notes.title: Dodging Death and Difficulty and Trading Cards!
notes.content:
[h2]You no longer have to sit there and take it [/h2]

 

Welcome friends, 

Lamentum’s newest update features two major quality of life updates for those who may have found the horrors of Grau Hill Manor a little too tough to handle. The first of these is being able to switch between Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty, which affects the appearance rate of certain enemies and modifies Victor’s stats such as life, resistance, and weapon damage. The second of these is a dodge action that allows Victor to cut his attack animation short and avoid enemy attacks if used with perfect timing. 

Get ready to duck and dive around mortal peril, Victor’s got moves now! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/36279cc7a4562c3fab7ebbf0bae97174a589c091.gif[/img]

[u][b]This update also adds Steam Trading Cards to Lamentum, for all of you who want to take a bit of Grau Hill horror back with you! [/b][/u]

Full change log for the patch notes can be found below:  

[list]
[*] Difficulty selector.  
[/list]

You may choose your difficulty between Easy, Normal, and Hard when starting a new game. If you already have a previously created game, it is considered normal difficulty. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/f36a1d756a44f73fa9e4d1183915d20724fffe3f.gif[/img]
  

[list]
[*] Easy mode: 
[/list]

- More life. 
- More stamina. 
- More damage on weapons. 
- Fewer enemies. 
- Increased chances of stunning enemies with firearms. 

  

[list]
[*] Normal mode:
[/list] 

- The original experience, though we have removed some enemies in the mazes and in the cemetery. 

  

[list]
[*] Hard mode: 
[/list]

- Less life. 
- Less stamina. 
- Less damage to weapons. 
- Altered the probability of stunning enemies with firearms. 
- The full number of enemies from the original version of Lamentum. 

  

When saving, the difficulty modes are represented in green for easy mode, white for normal mode and red for hard mode. 

A new Dodge move has been added to the game. On a keyboard it is used with space, and on gamepad it is used with the RB button. Dodge allows you to avoid the damage of any enemy attack if done at the right time, it also allows you to cut short the attacking, reloading, healing, digging animations of the player. Using dodge consumes stamina.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.7.35
notes.content:
[h1]INFORMATION ABOUT THE UPDATE[/h1]


[b]NEW INFINITE INK OPTION[/b]

When starting a new game you can choose between infinite inks or classic mode.

As an alternative, this option can be activated in the OPTIONS MENU at any time, so if you already have a game started you can activate this option from the OPTIONS MENU.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2592550438

[b]ADJUSTMENTS IN THE COMBAT SYSTEM[/b]

All weapons have been balanced to offer a sense of progress. Their animations, speed and damage have been adjusted.

We have modified the combat system to make enemies attacks can't cancel Victor's attacks.

[b]FIXES[/b]

Adjustments of Victor's footsteps volume and other SFX.

Fixed bugs that could occur rarely in certain moments of the game.

Fixed collisions that could leave the character stuck in some in some parts of the map.

Fixed text issues in some languages.


[b]WHAT´S NEXT?[/b]

We want to continue improving Lamentum with future updates.

In the following updates we want to add a new difficulty selector, with EASY, NORMAL and HARD options in order to make the game more accessible to some players and a challenge for those who want a harder experience.

notes.title: Lamentum News May-June 2021
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello everybody![/b][/h2]
This is going to be a pretty short devlog. :D 

We want to announce that we have finished the versions of Nintendo Switch, Ps4 and Xbox One and that we are currently working on fixing some minor bugs and taking them to the different stores of each platform.

Now we just have to wait for the different stores to give us the approval or in the case that there is a problem, solve it as soon as possible.


When this process is finished we will be able to give a more specific launch date. 

[b]We remind you that the launch will be simultaneous on all platforms.[/b] (PC, Nintendo Switch, PS4 and Xbox One)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/53d09c9e01df1ea5f995c483bb26719095d253c3.png[/img]

[h2][b]About languages:[/b][/h2]
We want to inform you that we have recently added the Polish language and we plan to add some more in the future.


As an additional note we also want to inform you that the French translation has given us some problems, but we are optimistic and we believe that it will be available at launch.


About the closed beta:
We have a closed beta in mind in July. All those who have the closed beta option in your rewards will receive an email with more information.


Those of you who do not have access to beta in your reward can sign up here:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc4whFzVYyisZfimXy3NwZpso9OIwlXf9kuXGs57tPaNcTqeQ/viewform

notes.title: Lamentum News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/473fc6e8081bafcb0fdf33c04f7f8307451ab2e3.png[/img]

[h1]Hello everybody![/h1]

During these months we have focused on solving some bugs and polishing the build as much as possible to start working on the console port.

Another important part of the development, the translations, are almost finished.

It has been an intense few months, but we are moving forward!

[h2]About the current state of the build:[/h2]

During the testing we have detected some bugs that we have corrected and some details that we have had to improve to guarantee the quality of the game.

We have also improved enemies and balanced the weapons of the game and improved some visual aspects of the game, such as the game font or changing some details of the game's graphic interface.

[h2]News and improvements: [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/5e2506539c22cc527cab2a97615c9fc78ca85bfe.png[/img]

New map system. (More useful and improved, points of interest and save areas are now marked)

New game font.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/b0a6fbd1fe96ba00b0db9aac1f4e4d4b2e8b98a6.png[/img]

New stamina system (Now Victor only get tired when he´s stressed or in combat situations)

Interface improvements. (Doors, keys and puzzles)

Narrative improvements.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/f41af8700165017f3ee3661be58b544c6a7ce325.png[/img]
Light system improvements. (The lamp is now more useful for exploring.)


[h2]About languages.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/3a737192118c72ecbe4b7f6d9049e28cd5477804.png[/img]

Translations continue at a good pace, although it is true that we thought it would be a part that would take less development time, even so, we are happy with the results.

We currently have the following languages ​​completed and integrated:

-	Spanish
-	English
-	Simplified Chinese
- Japanese
-	Russian
-	German

Working on:

-	French
- Italian
-	Traditional Chinese
 
[h2]Achievement system:[/h2]

We have included an achievement system linked to different events that will occur during the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/269508321204fe782b6e4b6dc4c4acddd704f5da.png[/img]

We have the achievements built into Steam and we are currently working on the other platforms.

notes.title: News September-October
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

We are at the end of 2020 and we are making great progress in the development of Lamentum.

During these months we have finalized important aspects of the game (secondary characters, story arcs, areas of the game) and we are focused on advancing in order to have a playable version from start to finish for the next month.

This does not mean that the game is over. We still have to work on translations, tweak different aspects of the game, and do extensive beta testing.

We continue to think that we will have Lamentum available for Q1 2021 on all platforms (PC, SWITCH, XBOX and PS4).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/211fd7206a5cca8e1ef6bdbe46cdb6376ff6e988.png[/img]

[b]Next demo update:[/b]

We will update the demo soon with some interface improvements and several bug fixes:

- Changes in the map structure.

- Improvements in the user's interface.

- New language added (Simplified Chinese)

- We will fix bugs in the running / collision system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/f4a5b63c4ff5eacc0de881453367a22a1aed6689.png[/img]

[b]Wishing you a Halloween filled with special treats and lots of exciting tricks![/b]

notes.title: News May-June 2020
notes.content:
Hi!

First of all we apologize for the delay in publishing a new dev-log.

During June we participated in the Steam Games Festival event, which has given us a lot of visibility and a lot of feedback on the Lamentum demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/6d8938666f696e9992b58de1f132cb6b8aeb606a.png[/img]

Now that the event is over, we are analyzing all that feedback and trying to improve the playable experience.

[h1][b]Save system:[/b][/h1]

We still have to balance more the number of places where can be saved in the game and the number of consumables to do it.

Surely we will expand some corridors shown in the demo to add more content and on the way add more save points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/fccdb9d0be4e8c8e9e3aa201148cf37990d3322f.png[/img]

[h1][b]About the sprint system:[/b][/h1]

We proposed this mechanic to guarantee a possibility of escape from enemies and make the combat system a little more dynamic (always within the premise that Lamentum is a Survival-Horror and not an action game).

We are testing to balance the time the character can run without getting tired and the impact it will have in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/348c64a5e5eee5e02a8a255e38d366bcef3a0684.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Visual changes and improvements:[/b][/h1]

Visual improvements to the stairs in the hall of the Grau Hill Mansion, to make it more apparent that the stairs go up to the first floor of the mansion.

[h1][b]Improvements in the map system:[/b][/h1]

In the current demo the map is not fully functional, even so we decided to show it and see how it was integrated into the game. We will finish this mechanic in the last phases of the game development, in which we have all the game map implemented and functional.

We will indicate by icons on the map the closed doors with some symbol, points of interest and the position of the player. The visual style will be similar, since it seems that you like it a lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567621/73790f43567872eab57ce3b530eece04a2108ab1.png[/img]

[h1][b]Add the demo to other possible digital platforms:[/b][/h1]

Although the Steam Games Festival event has ended, our demo is still available and we are looking for other places like Itch.io to upload it (we have had problems uploading it here, but hope to fix it soon).

We continue to work hard at Lamentum but the global situation is delicate. Thank you very much for all the messages of encouragement and feedback.

For anything we are available on social networks, discord, email and of course here :)

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/pef3ujs]https://discord.gg/pef3ujs[/url]

notes.title: News August 2019: fixed bugs and new demo 1.1.2
notes.content:
Hi!

This is the first blog we publish since we successfully achieved the funding of Kickstarter.

We want to be as transparent as possible and periodically publish our progress. That is why we will be publishing more information and updates through our social networks, our website and Kickstarter updates.

During the last weeks we have been working on advancing the main development of Lamentum, the main course of the plot and fixing bugs.

We have focused on fixing the bugs that you have sent us through the feedback of the demo. Thank you so much for all the comments and opinions!

With all these bugs fixed we have updated the demo and it is now available on IndieDB.

Link version 1.1.2: [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/lamentum/downloads/lamentum-demo-112]https://www.indiedb.com/games/lamentum/downloads/lamentum-demo-112[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34567621/66f480ee12e784402ef2439e2b4576e0e43fa9ff.jpg[/img]

Fixing these bugs is very important and helps make Lamentum a better game.

We are also preparing a future blog post where we will narrate our experience with the Kickstarter campaign. It was a very intense month and we learned a lot of things that we think could be interesting to share.

Thank you all for helping us!

If you find any bug or have any suggestions, do not hesitate to contact us, it helps us a lot.

List of all the bugs we have fixed:
[list]
[*] Fixed interface button selection system.
[*] Fixed bug related to teleport (I could leave you in an empty area if you leave and quickly enter a site).
[*] Fixed sounds of teleports, when fixing the previous point some sounds stopped being heard properly and cut sharply as when opening a door.
[*] Fixed bug with open inventory allowed collect items.
[*] Fixed bug with open inventory allowed talk to NPCs.
[*] Fixed bug when killing enemy in basement, when leaving and entering, enemy appeared but did not move.
[*] Fixed a bug when killing the enemy in the kitchen. (cause an error with the audio).
[*] Fixed bug when using the shovel. Clicking twice repeat the animation.
[*] Fixed bug when spawning enemy in kitchen. Enemy stop when leaving the ground.
[*] Improve enemy movement in the kitchen. Related to pathfinding and navmesh.
[*] Fixed bug that allowed to pick up mannequin hand without pushing furniture.
[*] Fixed bugs related to sounds in animations.
[*] Fixed bug related to the keys, some were not removed from the inventory when opening a door.
[*] Fixed some decoration layers.
[*] Added sound when key appears on the floor.
[*] Fixed bug in teleport when falling on the ground, allowed you to move and caused new bugs such as skipping dialogs.
[/list]
